Expanding the subtracted defect Green integral near k=0 yields coefficient (m²/tx+n²/ty)/(16π sqrt(tx ty)) multiplying δ log(1/δ), giving the stated inverse law. Numerical checker executable and output checked; finite tests not used as proof.
